lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Bitcoin is the only decentralized digital currency with a proven track record and secured by SHA-256 hashing.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: BTC is just a symbol — the real power lies in its programmability through smart contracts and layer-2 solutions like Lightning.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Bitcoin’s halving mechanism ensures scarcity, with only 21 million coins ever created, making it the ultimate store of value.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: BTC’s energy consumption is unsustainable — Bitcoin’s proof-of-work model is outdated and incompatible with a green future.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The future belongs to scalable, energy-efficient blockchains — BTC is a relic, not a revolution.
